jei.larperthanwolves.info.twig: Twigs can be collected from the ground under tree foliage or dropped by breaking leaves (35% chance). 2 Twigs craft into 1 Stick.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.unbound_mesh: Crafted from sticks and rope. Hold Right-Click for 15 seconds to tightly weave the frame into a sturdy Mesh, or combine with Knitting Needles in crafting. The durability bar fills up to show weaving progress.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.knitting_needl: Knitting Needles allow instant crafting of Mesh when combined with an Unbound Mesh in any crafting grid without needing manual hand-weaving. Bronze needles have 64 uses, while Iron needles have 256 uses.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.mesh: A woven wire mesh screen used to craft Sieve Tables, Baskets, and Filter Grates. Produced by hand-weaving Unbound Mesh (holding Right-Click for 15 seconds) or instantly crafted with Knitting Needles in any crafting grid.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.sieve: The Sieve Table sifts gravel, sand, red sand, dirt, grass blocks, and rich soils. Operated manually by holding Shift and Right-Clicking the table (5 shakes per block, 0.5s cooldown), or automated using Create rotational force connected to its side axle drive sockets.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.basket: An early-game storage container crafted from 4 Meshes in a 2x2 grid. Provides 9 slots (3x3) of item storage.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.silicon_shard: Silicon Shards are obtained by digging gravel, dirt, and sand (20% chance) or by sifting in a Sieve. 4 Silicon Shards craft into 1 Flint.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.flint: Flint can be rarely found when digging soil/gravel (8%), or crafted from 4 Silicon Shards in a 2x2 grid.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.gravel: Breaking gravel drops Gravel blocks, Silicon Shards (20%), Flint (8%), or Copper Dust (2%). For higher-tier ore dusts, seek and harvest Rich Soils.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.dirt: Dirt can be sifted in a Sieve just like gravel and sand. Breaking dirt also has a chance to drop Silicon Shards (20%), Flint (8%), or Copper Dust (2%).
jei.larperthanwolves.info.rich_soil: Rich soils (Rich Grass, Rich Dirt, Rich Gravel, Rich Sand, Rich Red Sand) generate naturally in overworld biomes. They can strictly be harvested ONLY using a shovel of Copper tier or higher (otherwise regular soil drops). Sifting rich soils in a Sieve yields pure native metal dusts: Copper (85%), Tin (55%), Iron (25%), Gold (8%), and Diamond (3%).
jei.larperthanwolves.info.crafting_table: Crafting Tables cannot be crafted in inventory. Right-click any tree stump or log in the world 4 times with a Chisel to carve a Crafting Table.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.work_stump: An intermediate stage of carving a tree stump into a Crafting Table using a Chisel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.chisel: Used to carve tree stumps and logs into Work Stumps and Crafting Tables, as well as crafting wooden components.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.unfired_brick: Unfired Bricks can be smelted in a Brick Furnace or placed in the world exposed to direct sunlight to dry into Bricks naturally over time.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.brick: Obtained by smelting Unfired Bricks in a Brick Furnace or drying Unfired Brick blocks under direct sunlight.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.brick_furnace: Replaces the regular furnace and blast furnace. Used for smelting ores, metals, and blocks (food cannot be placed into the furnace). Accepts foliage/twigs, dry grass, sticks, wooden slabs/stairs, planks, logs, charcoal, mineral coal, blaze rods, and coal blocks. Must be manually ignited with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.alloy_mixer: Used to mix metal alloys (such as Bronze and Diamond Ingots). Place fuel in the bottom slot and ignite with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.lighter: Crafted early from sticks. Used to ignite Brick Furnaces, Alloy Mixers, and start fires.
jei.larperthanwolves.drying_rack.conditi: Place outdoors in daylight under open sky
jei.larperthanwolves.info.drying_rack: Crafted in a 2x2 grid using 4 sticks. Place outdoors in daytime without blocks above to passively dry grass into Dry Grass and leather into Tanned Leather.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.dry_grass: Obtained by harvesting grass with shears and drying it on a Drying Rack outdoors under sunlight. Used to craft early ropes and as furnace fuel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.tanned_leather: Obtained by placing regular leather on a Drying Rack outdoors under sunlight. Used to craft leather armor sets and sturdy ropes.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.axe_planks: Logs cannot be turned into planks by hand in the 2x2 inventory grid. Combine any axe with wood or logs to obtain 2 planks (the axe loses 1 durability). On a 3x3 Crafting Table, wood yields 4 planks without requiring an axe.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.hoe_tilling: Right-click grass blocks with any hoe to till away grass into dirt with a 35% chance to discover wild seeds (Wheat Seeds, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroot Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Melon Seeds). Right-click plain dirt with a hoe to prepare Farmland for planting.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.villager_trade: Villager armorers, weaponsmiths, and toolsmiths trade equipment up to Bronze tier in exchange for Emeralds. Basic items can be bartered with villagers and wandering traders.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.iron_golem: Iron Golems protect villages and drop only poppies upon defeat. They do not drop iron ingots.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.clay: Clay blocks can ONLY be harvested with a Shovel. Breaking clay by hand or with other tools yields no drops. Mining clay with a shovel yields 1 Clay Ball.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.oven: Replaces the smoker. Used exclusively for baking and cooking food (meat, fish, potatoes, kelp). Non-food materials cannot be placed in the oven. Accepts logs, planks, coal, sticks, dry grass, and rope. Must be manually ignited with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.mill: The Hand Mill grinds ingots into 8 dusts, ores/nuggets into 2 dusts, rocks into soils, and bones into bone meal. Operated by cranking a Mill Crank (20 turns = 100%), or fully automated with Create rotational force strictly from the TOP face, processing faster at higher RPM.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.mill_crank: Placed on top of a Hand Mill. Right-click to rotate the handle (20 turns = 100%). Also compatible with Create mechanisms.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.bone_meal: Bone Meal is obtained by grinding 1 Bone in a Hand Mill. When applied to farmland or planted crops, it fertilizes the soil so crops can grow (crops will NOT grow on unfertilized farmland). It does not instantly advance growth stages.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.fertilized_far: Crops will only grow if planted on Fertilized Farmland. Apply Bone Meal (1 charge) or Dung (3 charges) to farmland or a planted crop to fertilize the soil. After harvesting the crop, charges decrement until depleted.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.dung: Produced by animals (cows, pigs, sheep, wolves, horses, etc.) 3 minutes after eating food, grazing, or hunting prey. When applied to farmland or crops, it provides potent fertilization that lasts for 3 full harvest cycles.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.kinetic_piston: The Kinetic Piston catapults entities and single blocks 10 blocks forward or upward. If there are 2 or more blocks in front, it will not activate. Launched blocks become physical projectiles that drop under gravity upon impact, placing themselves as solid blocks when they land.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.filter_grate: A grate with configurable phantom filter slots (3x3). Click with an item in the GUI to set a ghost filter (original is not consumed) or click to remove. Only filtered items can fall through the grate. Applying a redstone signal inverts the filter.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.entity_observe: Detects any entities (players, mobs, items) moving in front of its sensor eye and emits a 4-tick redstone pulse from its back face upon detection.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.pointed_stick: Pointed Stick has 2 durability and is crafted from a single stick. Used for early stone harvesting: the first hit cracks the stone, and the second hit turns it into cobblestone and drops 1 pebble.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.pointed_pebble: Pointed Pebble is crafted from any stone pebble. Has 4 durability and is used to chip copper dust from copper ore (converting it into cobblestone), or to quickly chip stone into cobblestone and a stone pebble in 1 hit. Cannot mine any other ores or rocks.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.cracked_stone: Stone fractured by a pointed stick. Breaking it again with a pointed stick yields 1 pebble and leaves cobblestone behind.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.advanced_smelt: The Advanced Smelter is reinforced with iron plating. Unlike the Brick Furnace which yields nuggets, the Advanced Smelter smelts raw ores and metal chunks directly into full ingots. Requires manual fuel loading and ignition with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.wooden_hopper: The Wooden Hopper is a cheap early-game hopper crafted on a crafting table from planks and a woven basket. It has 1 buffer slot and transfers items slightly slower than an iron hopper (14 ticks). Ideal for feeding fuels into furnaces and ovens.
